card.name: Words after change or modify verbs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (then, few, your, it, a, to) right after a verb or noun about changing, altering, improving or correcting something. Also partway through the names Tirpitz and ritonavir.

modes.label: After change verbs
modes.description: A small word follows a verb or noun meaning alter, improve, correct or update.
modes.example: Queen Mary, George V’s wife, altered<< it>> to include a sunken garden.

modes.label: Inside names
modes.description: Partway through the proper name Tirpitz or the drug name ritonavir.

card.writes: It suppresses override and modification words, so it seems to make an upcoming change or override word less likely.
card.plain: It fires on small words right after talk of changing or improving something, and inside a couple of odd names.
